summary: BotWave is an FM broadcasting system that uses a server-client architecture to manage multiple Raspberry Pi transmitters remotely. It allows you to control and coordinate audio streaming operations across geographically dispersed hardware nodes from a central location. The project is open source and built using Python.
goodFor: This is a suitable tool if you maintain a network of Raspberry Pi-based FM radio transmitters and need centralised remote management.
watchOut: Managing multiple remote hardware endpoints introduces operational overhead regarding network reliability and physical maintenance at the transmitter sites.
deployNotes: As a Python application, you will typically need to manage dependencies within a virtual environment and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for the server component.
